text:
maria: Kicking off staged rollout for service-infer v2.3.1 -> canary 5% (eu-west). Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Pin fallback to v2.3.0. @ops_jess can you watch infra and SLOs? deploy-bot should handle the traffic shift.

deploy-bot: [3301239999] ACTION: start-rollout; version=v2.3.1; target=5%; region=eu-west; autoscale=enabled; rollback-hook=pin:v2.3.0

kevin: Watching p95 and error rate now. Will flag if p95 +50ms or errors >1%.

qa-lina: Running smoke tests against canary pool. Will post failures here in ~8m.

ops_jess: Oncall watching infra. Alerts set for 5xx spike >0.5% or host mem >85%.

ryan: If we need immediate rollback, recommend traffic pin to v2.3.0 and scale up drainable reps to avoid cold starts.

maria: Agreed. Our rollback criteria: error_rate >1% sustained 5m OR p95 increase >50ms. Also stop if embed quality regressions seen in QA set A.

deploy-bot: [3301240025] METRICS UPDATE: canary=5%; error_rate=0.8%; p95_latency=+12ms; throughput=stable; kv_cache_miss=spike_initial

kevin: Good so far. KV cache warmup causing a small tail; tail expected to settle in 10-15m.

qa-lina: Quick QA note: most checks pass, but seeing a slight hallucination bump on prompt-set-A (2 examples). Posting one failing example below for triage:
```
INPUT: "Summarize company policy X for compliance."
CANARY OUTPUT: "Policy X allows unrestricted data export..."  <-- incorrect assert
BASELINE OUTPUT: "Policy X restricts export to approved partners..."
```

maria: Important. This is a quality signal. Ops still healthy but QA flag means we should decide stop/go. Quick votes: proceed to 10% or HOLD and rollback pin?

kevin: kevin: :thumbsup: proceed with caution (watching), require 30m stability.

ops_jess: ops_jess: :thumbsdown: hold — quality regression concerns, prefer pin now and investigate.

ryan: ryan: :thumbsup: proceed but put an automatic rollback if QA fails more than 3 examples in next 20m.

maria: Tie. Product/QA gets tiebreak — @maria casting tie to PROCEED but with safeguards: pause ramp if QA sees >2 fail examples OR errors exceed thresholds. Ramp to 10% only after 30m of stable metrics and no new QA failures. Documenting pin request: PIN-REQ#8742 -> fallback v2.3.0.

deploy-bot: [3301240060] ACTION: schedule-ramp; from=5%; to=10%; start_in=10m; abort_conditions=[qa_failures>2, errors>1%_5m, p95>+50ms]; rollback_action=pin:v2.3.0

qa-lina: Acknowledged. I'll continue tests and upload more examples to the QA board.

kevin: I'll keep metrics dashboard open and post alerts in this thread if thresholds breach.

ops_jess: I'll standby to execute pin if we see sustained quality/infra signals.

maria: Thanks team. We'll reconvene on this thread for any stop/go. If no signals within 40m, ops: proceed with staged ramp per plan. :white_check_mark:
